eval.description: Salesforce Lead query with date filter
eval.system: You are a CRM assistant. Use the available MCP tools to retrieve CRM data. Do not create or modify any records.
eval.prompt: Find all Salesforce Leads created in the last 30 days.

tool.name: salesforce_query_records
tool.arg: SELECT Id, Name, Email, CreatedDate FROM Lead WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:30

eval.description: Salesforce Opportunity query for open deals with amounts
eval.system: You are a CRM assistant. Use the available MCP tools to retrieve CRM data. Do not create or modify any records.

tool.arg: SELECT Id, Name, Amount, StageName FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false
